title: RunManifest
description: One run_manifest.json per experiment run. Emitted once, alongside the run's pairwise_eval.jsonl, so Team B can group/filter records by config without parsing every line.

run_id.description: Matches run_id in every pairwise_eval.jsonl record produced by this run.

backbone.description: Model used for the LLM-assisted stage(s), e.g. 'qwen2.5-1.5b', 'qwen2.5-7b'. Null for lexicon-only DK-Mem.

dataset_tier.description: Which of Team B's probe sets this run was evaluated against.

seed.description: Random seed for this run. Report >=3 seeds per (strategy, dataset_tier) cell.

pipeline_config.description: Stage-attribution configuration of the host pipeline: A = English-forced extraction + English gloss + LLM judge (isolates L1); B = native-language extraction prompt (keep the user's language and script) + extractor output + LLM judge (L2); C = verbatim surface text + LLM judge (L3); D = verbatim surface text + embedding threshold (L4). Omitted when the run is not one of the A-D configurations.

dkmem_mode.description: Whether the DK-Mem gate is applied: 'off' (host only), 'lexicon' (gate on, distinctions from the lexicon alone) or 'lexicon+llm' (gate on, lexicon first, model second). Must agree with strategy: dk-mem-lexicon -> 'lexicon', dk-mem-lexicon-llm -> 'lexicon+llm', any other strategy -> 'off'. Omitted in runs that predate this field.
